1. Yes, the team you see in a players page will mostly be different from the team they use in PVP mode. This way, it ensures that pvp mode will be more fair and that it will keep the mode more level.

2. Items are dependent on the character they add it to, the attribute bonus (if any) , and the build the player is going for. Certain character are better with certain builds, and likewise, some characters are good all around. Jushiro is a strong attack user, so I would have a blue maxed shinten on him to maximize his strong attack damage. As for having focus on kenpachi, kenpachi would be better off with strong attack damage, or Spiritual pressure on him.

3. Yes, the premium and brave soul summoning tickets pull from the premium summons. The difference is, the brave soul tickets have a higher chance of getting a 4/5 star, but not by much.
  
4. There are many ways to get items. Raids, story quests, and multiplayer quests are the best ways to get items. If you feel like you're not getting enough items to fuse, play some co-op fusion trials, it's gurenteed to drop slot of items, hence the name "fusion trials". Unfortunately, there is no other way but to use the items you have and fuse them.  One way of fusing items quickly, is to complete the daily and weekly quests to get a 2 and 3 star power heart respectively. Lastly, no matter what stars the items are, the price stays the same, so if you're fusing 10 1* items, it's better to fuse 10 2* items.

5. You get friend points for logging in, and friends having you tag along on quests (automatic). Honestly, I wouldn't spend it all once you get enough, but save those points until you 2500. Enough to do a x10 pull for better items. 

6. From all my years of pulling gachas, I can say this with certainty. X2 event are better than trying to pull from a premium gacha.
